verdict.rationale: Missive ships an official MCP server that lets external AI apps like Claude or ChatGPT access your conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts. The changelog gives "ask Claude to summarize your inbox" as an example use. Missive also has its own in-app assistant with sessions, but the evidence only shows it answering from Missive's documentation, not from your mailbox. Missing for 10: documented built-in assistant Q&A across the whole inbox and calendar, explicit grounded or cited answers to questions like who said what or what's outstanding, and independent hands-on corroboration.
